features.title: Welcome to Caelestia Updates
features.description: Whenever we introduce exciting new features, they will appear here so you never miss out. Enjoy the refined aesthetic and improved functionality!

features.title: Taskbar Update Indicator
features.description: Caelesita can now be updated from system tray. Hover to show available options, Left click to open Update page and Right click to check for update. Can be enabled from Settings -> Panels -> Taskbar -> Toggle & rearrange -> Updates

features.title: Integrated more than ever
features.description: 1. Alt+F4 no longer closes the shell. 2. Whenever you open and close any drawer, it will seamlessly return focus to the window you were previously using! 3. Kwin native protocols are used to interact with windows, creating much faster experience!

features.title: Text Recognition (OCR)
features.description: Extract text from any image or region on your screen instantly. Use the new Meta+Shift+D shortcut to select an area, and the recognized text will be automatically copied to your clipboard.
